indicator_definition: This indicator measures the number of patent applications filed with the European Patent Office (EPO) per million inhabitants. Patents protect inventions and indicate innovation output. A higher number reflects greater innovative activity. Data are compiled by Eurostat from EPO records.
rationale: Patent applications are a widely used proxy for innovation output. Countries with strong patent activity benefit from technological progress and competitive advantage. Progress means a sustained increase in patent applications per million inhabitants.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled by Eurostat from EPO records based on the residence of the inventor. Applications are counted at the priority date and attributed to the year of first filing. Data are published annually.
indicator_name: Patent applications to the European Patent Office
